title.zh: SEC gives Bitcoin-heavy trusts a new 15% window to venture beyond existing listing rules
title.en: SEC gives Bitcoin-heavy trusts a new 15% window to venture beyond existing listing rules

current_state.zh: The SEC approved a Nasdaq Texas rule allowing qualifying commodity-linked trusts to hold up to 15% of net asset value in otherwise ineligible assets, including specified digital commodities, while preserving streamlined listings and permitting active strategies.
current_state.en: The SEC approved a Nasdaq Texas rule allowing qualifying commodity-linked trusts to hold up to 15% of net asset value in otherwise ineligible assets, including specified digital commodities, while preserving streamlined listings and permitting active strategies.
